Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1263
Claimant:
Katie Reese
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
07/08/2023
The insured reported a left-turn collision at an intersection, and the claimant was identified as the driver of the other
vehicle. Initial contact was made with the claimant's attorney, who asked that all communication go through their
office.
07/25/2023
Photos taken at the scene show the damage to both vehicles, and they confirm several details of the reported impact.
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the account rests on the parties and the photographs.
08/14/2023
The police report confirms that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The insured's driver is listed
on the policy, and the policy was in force at the time of loss.
08/18/2023
The damage to the claimant's vehicle is mostly consistent with the described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle
is known from our records or the vehicle history check.
09/01/2023
The claimant reports a shoulder injury, and the kind and force of the impact appear to match that injury. Medical
records show treatment that followed a usual course.
09/15/2023
The claimant's account of the collision has stayed the same in each conversation so far, including the initial call, the
recorded statement, and the follow-up with counsel.
11/29/2023
No earlier injury to the same area of the body is known from prior claims or medical history on file. Nothing in the
records suggests the damage existed before coverage began.
12/30/2023
Treatment tapered off as the claimant's condition improved, and the most recent provider notes describe steady
recovery. The attorney has requested a settlement evaluation based on the treatment records.
02/10/2024
Based on the photos, police report, medical records, and consistent statements, the claim appears to be a
straightforward left-turn collision. The file is being referred for a settlement evaluation with the claimant's counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
